Cristiano Ronaldo Provisionally Suspended by Portuguese Federation

Cristiano Ronaldo has been provisionally suspended by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF) following disciplinary proceedings opened over his departure from the national team camp. The 41-year-old striker left the squad's base in Copenhagen before a match after being an unused substitute against Norway in the Nations League. Media reports indicated the suspension was provisional after his walkout.
